insurer: Zurich Kotak General Insurance Company (India) Limited
plan_name: Health Premier (part of Health Maximiser Combi Product)

room_rent.note: Room rent cap is optional — insured can opt for 'Cap on Room Rent' for a premium discount; if not opted, full room rent and associated expenses are covered up to SI. Proportionate deduction applies if opted and room exceeds eligible limit. ICU charges exempt from proportionate deduction.

icu.display: No cap (proportionate deduction not applied to ICU)
icu.note: Policy explicitly states proportionate deductions will not be applied in respect of ICU Charges.

copayment.display: None (zone-based co-pay if treated in higher zone)
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay for treatment within eligible zone. Zone II insured treated in Zone I: 10%; Zone III in Zone I: 20%; Zone III in Zone II: 10%. No co-pay for accident hospitalisation outside zone.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 10% of SI, max ₹1L/eye/year
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of Base Sum Insured up to ₹1,00,000 per eye per Policy Year. Other benefits (maternity, CI, PA) have separate sub-limits per schedule.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in base plan.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Policy states 36/24 months as mentioned in Policy Schedule. Best achievable is 24 months per schedule option. Reducible via portability continuity credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, hernia, hydrocele, BPH, joint replacements, stones, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.display: Covered (36mo wait, up to sub-limit in schedule)
maternity.note: Inbuilt benefit covering delivery, C-section, lawful MTP, pre/post-natal expenses, newborn baby cover and vaccination expenses. Max 2 deliveries across all policy periods. 36-month waiting period. Sub-limit as per Policy Schedule.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase in Base SI per claim-free year; maximum cap as specified in Policy Schedule (not stated in wording). Not applicable on restored SI or for maternity/newborn/vaccination/CI/PA claims.

restoration.note: Restored SI not available for same illness/complication already claimed in that year for same insured. Not triggered on first claim unless accident claim exceeds Base SI. Unused restored SI lapses at year end.

pre_hosp.note: Number of days specified in Policy Schedule, not stated in wording text.

post_hosp.note: Number of days specified in Policy Schedule, not stated in wording text.

day_care.note: Extensive list of 405 day-care procedures covered across ENT, ophthalmology, oncology, urology, orthopaedics, gynaecology, etc.

domiciliary.note: Excluded conditions include asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, arthritis, gout, tonsillitis, influenza, etc.

ayush.note: Inpatient or day-care AYUSH treatment at recognised AYUSH hospitals covered up to Base Sum Insured.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for donor covered up to Base SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation and organ acquisition costs for donor excluded.

ambulance.display: Up to limit in Policy Schedule
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to schedule limit for emergency hospitalisation and inter-hospital transfers. Air ambulance also covered (within Base SI) up to schedule limit.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic surgery as a named benefit or exclusion. Day-care list includes some advanced procedures (stereotactic radiosurgery, VMAT, etc.).

consumables.note: Annexure III lists consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) as non-payable. Sterilised gloves are payable; unsterilised are not.

global_cover.note: Policy states no claims payable unless cause of action arises in India. Critical Illness and Personal Accident optional covers are worldwide.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document for new policies; not applicable at renewal.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; continuity benefits for waiting periods transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, treatment outside India, external congenital anomalies, sleep disorders, dental (non-accident), refractive error <7.5D, ECP/EECP/hyperbaric O2 (outpatient)

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness Cover (18 CIs), Personal Accident Cover (death & PTD), Cap on Room Rent (premium discount), Hospital Daily Cash, Convalescence Benefit, Air Ambulance, Maternity Benefit
